  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma excision should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions on the face, such as lentigo maligna.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large acral lesions.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large genital lesions.",
  "The recommendation has a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21).",
  "The recommendation is cited from the American Academy of Dermatology guideline with PMID 30392755.",
  "The recommendation is cited from the European Association of Dermato‑Oncology guideline with PMID 39709737.",
  "The recommendation is for primary excision of suspected melanoma.",
  "The recommendation includes performing histological diagnosis after excision."
